decisions.briefing: Markets were essentially flat today (NASDAQ -0.2%, S&P 500 -0.0%) with no clear directional signal. Cash on hand ($389.29) sits below our $500 deployment threshold, so per our playbook we held all 7 existing positions and skipped new buys rather than forcing a trade on a neutral day.

market_education.summary_en: Major indices closed nearly unchanged today, with the NASDAQ dipping just 0.2% and the S&P 500 roughly flat. There were no major market-moving headlines in today's session, suggesting investors were in a wait-and-see mode rather than reacting to any specific catalyst. Low-volatility, directionless days like this are common between larger macro events such as earnings releases or Fed announcements.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大盤幾乎持平，納斯達克指數微跌0.2%，標普500指數則幾近零變動。今天的交易時段內並未出現重大市場消息，顯示投資人普遍採取觀望態度，而非對特定事件作出反應。這種低波動、方向不明確的交易日，在重大總體經濟事件（如財報公布或聯準會決策）之間相當常見。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: "Dry powder" refers to cash kept on the sidelines, ready to invest when a genuinely attractive opportunity appears, rather than being deployed just for the sake of staying fully invested. On a neutral day with too little cash to meaningfully size a new position anyway, holding that cash and waiting is a disciplined choice, not a missed opportunity.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「乾火藥」（Dry Powder）指的是投資人保留在場邊的現金，等待真正有吸引力的機會出現時才出手，而不是為了「把資金全部投入市場」而勉強交易。在方向不明、且現金水位也不足以有效建立新倉位的日子裡，按兵不動、耐心等待才是紀律的表現，而非錯失良機。
